summary: Configured 512MB zstd-compressed zram swap on node1, enabled it at boot via zram-generator, verified it takes priority over the existing disk-backed swap partition, and confirmed persistence across a real node restart (boot ID changed and zram swap auto-activated with correct priority afterward).
actions_performed: Inspected node1 baseline: RHEL 10.0, existing 2G disk swap on /dev/vda3 at priority -2, no zram-generator installed
Resolved a stuck zram0 kernel device (leftover from a failed first attempt) by removing the zram module and letting zram-generator recreate it cleanly
Started/verified systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service and dev-zram0.swap; confirmed /dev/zram0 active as 512M zstd swap at priority 100, ranked above disk swap (-2)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on node1
Issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) on node1, polled until exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed post-restart, confirming an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified post-reboot: zram0 swap automatically active again at 512M/zstd/priority 100 ahead of disk swap, with systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service and dev-zram0.swap both active

evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory swap configured
evidence.summary: zramctl shows /dev/zram0 with algorithm zstd, disksize 512M, mounted as [SWAP]; swapon --show confirms 512M zram0 entry

evidence.requirement: zram swap preferred over disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: swapon --show / /proc/swaps show /dev/zram0 at priority 100 vs /dev/vda3 disk swap at priority -2, both before and after reboot

zram-generator config file present (triggers static systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service/dev-zram0.swap via generator on every boot); confirmed active immediately after a real reboot with no manual intervention
Captured pre-restart boot_id (7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146) and healthy zram+disk swap state

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now issued (connection dropped as expected); post-reboot boot_id read back as 9cdb98dc-54d4-4a43-9140-3eb3795ecd39, proving a distinct boot occurred
Post-reboot swapon/zramctl/free -h and systemctl status confirm zram0 swap (512M, zstd, priority 100) automatically reconstituted and active, disk swap also present at priority -2
